questions: Are old-model errors concentrated near weak first-sine signals or conflicts between components?
Does line order change repeatability as well as mean action?
Do switching features or higher moments improve prediction under source-seed-held-out nested tuning?
outer: Leave one entire physical source seed out; original/reflected inputs and all response rounds remain together.
inner: Four source-seed folds, deterministic shuffle inside each outer training set. All tuning uses inner predictions only.
selection: Per-family parameter choice by inner NLL; additionally an inner-NLL adaptive family selector and an inner-mean-action-MSE selector. Report all families; no post hoc substitution into original gate.
thresholds: Residual strata abs(S1)<=0.1; C1*S1<0; higher-sine sign conflict. Descriptive, chosen after earlier results; not confirmatory tests.
